name: Koigakubo Yuri
source:
Yuri is the homeroom teacher of Ryuuji's class.
She likes to do things at her own pace and is timid towards Taiga's way of speaking out. Since her twenties are almost over, Yuri is in a hurry to get married soon and she even tries to dress well so as to be able to get into a relationship quicker.
